figures.title: Distance from training inputs: length_response
figures.scope: Input-only geometry, not prediction accuracy, joint support, safety or causality. No OOD cutoff. Orange squares: outside a marginal range. Red crosses: changed a Train-constant input (omitted from distance).

reference_geometry.method: Euclidean nearest Train input distance after dividing each varying column by its Train range
reference_geometry.scope: Descriptive geometry, not a support, accuracy, safety or causal guarantee. Inside every marginal range can still leave the joint observed design. Distance depends on coordinates, feature count and sampling density; no OOD threshold is fitted. Constant columns are omitted from distances and changes are flagged separately. Identical input rows are counted once for reference neighbor spacing, not as independent observations.
